turns.response_html:
Solar flux measures the intensity of solar radiation reaching a surface. It primarily drives planetary temperatures, powers photosynthesis, and influences radio communications by ionizing the Earth's upper atmosphere.

Key Effects

  • Climate & Weather: Determines the energy balance that dictates global temperature patterns.
  • Space Weather: High flux levels can expand the atmosphere, increasing satellite drag and disrupting GPS signals.
  • Energy Production: Dictates the efficiency and output of solar power systems.

turns.prompt_text: what does soldering liquid flux do
turns.response_html:
Soldering liquid flux removes oxidation from metal surfaces to ensure a strong, clean bond. It lowers surface tension, allowing molten solder to flow smoothly and adhere properly to the joint.

Core Functions

  • Oxidation Removal: Chemically cleans the metal so solder can "wet" the surface.
  • Improved Heat Transfer: Helps heat spread evenly across the connection.
  • Prevents Re-oxidation: Forms a protective barrier while the joint is hot.
